system.description:
When using this skill, you may consume one [Toxin] item with an Item Rank of at most [CR - 5 (minimum 1)] that inflicts a Bad Status. When you deal damage with «Basic Weapon Attack», you can inflict the same Bad Status the consumed [Toxin] item would have inflicted to the target of that attack. Treat this effect as a Combat Status.
(Fate 1 & Self: Poison-User, Curseblade, Avenger): If you have reached your Limit for this skill, you may pay this cost to use it again.

A special skill in which a weapon is charged with a curse and its effect is exerted directly from the wound of the attacked opponent.
